_role: A: driver cancelled as no-show after threshold; rider-filed, stresses 'I never pressed cancel'

dispute_ticket.description: The app shows that the driver cancelled the ride, yet I was charged S$7.00. I never pressed cancel. Why should I pay a fee for something the driver did?

chat_logs.content: Arrived at Bukit Panjang Plaza, Jelebu Road entrance. Black Cerato.
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 25s, no response).
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $7.00 applied.
I overslept, I'm so sorry. Can you wait?

app_events.details: Rider R-8416 booked trip RYDE-CS-006 from Bukit Panjang Plaza (Jelebu Road entrance) to National University Hospital. Pickup 06:45.
Driver D-2209 (Kwok Chee Meng, Kia Cerato (SKV 3306 C)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 3 min free wait period ends at 06:47.
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 25s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-2209. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$7.00 charged to rider payment method (credit_card).
Driver D-2209 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 06:44:00 with GPS at the pickup from 06:44 to 06:55. The driver pressed cancel at 06:55:00, a wait of 11 minutes, clearly past this trip's 8-minute no-show threshold. The rider is right that the driver pressed cancel, but the policy covers the no-show cancellation the driver presses after the threshold; the rider's 06:58 chat ('I overslept') does not dispute the no-show. The S$7.00 fee is due.
